summary: Omarchy's Signed: place a saved signature and a date on the right lines of a PDF; the app has no accessibility tree
prompt: Signed is open on ~/Documents/contract.pdf. Sign it for the Client (not the Studio): put the saved signature "Jordan Lee" on the Client signature line on page 2, put today's date on the Date line below it, and save the signed copy as ~/Documents/contract-signed.pdf. Do it in Signed.
